description: One controller hit 200+ organizations in 11 days, with access confirmed at nine. Storm-0940 used it to try sign-ins at 2,250+ Microsoft 365 tenants. Zscaler tied a theft of personal data on about 67,000 people from South Korean financial firms to it. Check Point read operator consoles: one operator stole 300+ iOS code-signing certificates. GMO found it on the attack infrastructure behind breaches of Japanese companies. Microsoft names two North Korean actors using it.

name: Cairn
actors: CL-STA-1238; CRAFTY FALCON; Retail card-theft operator; AIA0001; AIA0002
description: Given a domain and a one-line goal, ran 25 operations against at least 19 organizations, with access or data taken at 10. Gambit counted 105 attack projects launched between 10 and 15 September and at least 27 companies compromised; NorForge found 20+ exposed panels and confirmed a live uploader web shell at a hardware-parts vendor. Google separately saw it used against a US aerospace target.

name: CyberStrikeAI
actors: Unattributed operators; CRAFTY FALCON; Unattributed operator (Japan)
description: Implant deployed on education-sector networks in Latin America and Africa. The operator set the plan; the model on the command server chose and issued the technical steps: credential dumping, lateral movement, DCSync and Golden Ticket attacks, then database export. TrendAI separately confirmed it running 44 agents against at least 19 organizations, 16 or more in Japan, in October; deep compromise reached only a small share. Team Cymru found its banner on an IP Amazon had published from an AI-augmented actor's infrastructure, with NetFlow to the FortiGate devices that actor targeted.

name: Hermes Agent
